photos.desc: Dromaeosaurus albertensis (TMP 1984.003.0005, detail), Royal Tyrrell Museum, Drumheller, Alberta, 2025-07-13; cast, Campanian, from Dinosaur Park
Skeletal reconstruction of Dromaeosaurus albertensis, detail of trunk. Dinosaur Park Formation, Dinosaur Provincial Park, Alberta. On display at the Royal Tyrrell Museum, Alberta, Canada.
A scale chart of dromaeosaurids including Microraptor , Dromaeosaurus , Austroraptor , Velociraptor , Utahraptor , and Deinonychus (left to right).
Dromaeosaurus albertensis , a dromeosaurid which lived in North America 70 million years ago.
Life restoration of Dromaeosaurus , created using pencil.
